The datacenter capacity rollforward failed due to an incorrect value in the 'Compute Pool #8100' sheet of the output workbook.
The test_legacy_node_checks in test_output.py failed with an AssertionError during the call phase. While the output workbook was created and sheet names were correct, the verifier reported 'FAIL: Compute Pool #8100!A1 must be Nimbus Compute'. Avoid incorrect cell mapping or naming conventions in the generated sheets, as the verifier specifically checks cell A1 for the expected pool name.
